2607.01936.title: CausalSteward: An Agentic Divide-Conquer-Combine Copilot for Causal Discovery
2607.01936.paper_summary: Learning causal models from high-dimensional data is a significant challenge, particularly in real-world settings where violations of core assumptions lead to causal identifiability issues. Although massive amounts of prior knowledge are available, and contain valuable causal information, effectively integrating this knowledge into the causal discovery process remains an open problem. We introduce CausalSTeward (CAST), a novel human-in-the-loop framework for interactively assembling large causal models. CausalSteward is a multi-agent collaborative system that tackles high-dimensional causality through a divide-and-conquer approach where large clusters of variables are iteratively partitioned and then separately analyzed. Our framework fuses prior knowledge with a data-driven approach by using tailored tools such as retrieval augmented generation and conditional independence tests. Finally, we use this work to examine the capabilities and limitations of causal reasoning in multi-agent frameworks, and how the human-in-the-loop can contribute to accurate and trustworthy results.
2607.01936.paper_summary_zh: 從高維數據中學習因果模型是一項重大挑戰，特別是在現實世界中，核心假設的違反導致因果可識別性問題。儘管有大量的先前知識可用，並且包含有價值的因果信息，但有效地將這些知識整合進因果發現過程仍然是一個未解決的問題。我們介紹了CausalSTeward（CAST），這是一個新穎的人機協作框架，用於互動地組裝大型因果模型。CausalSteward是一個多代理協作系統，通過分而治之的方法來處理高維因果性，將大量變量集群進行迭代劃分，然後分別分析。我們的框架通過使用量身定制的工具，如檢索增強生成和條件獨立性測試，將先前知識與數據驅動的方法融合在一起。最後，我們利用這項工作來檢視多代理框架中因果推理的能力和局限性，以及人機協作如何促進準確和可靠的結果。
